title: BlackRock opens tokenized money market fund with $100 million in assets to Hong Kong investors
reason: Major adoption milestone from a top-tier asset manager entering a new regional market with tokenized products.

sources.summary: BlackRock has launched and opened its HKD Digital Liquidity Fund to retail and institutional investors in Hong Kong.
The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.
